release_name: Live TV v5.1.2 — Compact Header, Zero-Scroll Mobile & Scroll-Free Remote
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: ⚡ Prominent Header Update Icon & Status Pill: Added permanent, always-visible update pill and updater icon in the top header displaying real-time GitHub release status

🗜️ Ultra-Compact Desktop Header (Zero Horizontal Scroll): Redesigned header buttons with compact padding, concise labels, and responsive collapse ensuring all 16 tools fit perfectly without horizontal scrolling on any window size
📱 Scroll-Free Phone TV Player (Zero Vertical Scroll): Optimized viewport and component heights so the entire mobile player, channel title, playback bar, and quick channel surfer fit on screen at once

🎮 Compact Scroll-Free Phone Remote (Zero Horizontal Scroll): Slimmed D-pad from 220px to 144px, eliminated redundant volume buttons, streamlined quick tools, and introduced a 1-tap collapsible channel keypad drawer
🚀 Full Channel Access: Smooth scrolling and lazy-loaded rendering of all 2,989 channels with pinned category navigation
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Zero commercial interruptions, popups, or tracking scripts
